claims.claim: Mm6 Yamaha keyboard with pitch bend
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows a Yamaha keyboard, but the model 'Mm6' is not visible. The pitch bend feature is not confirmed as the keyboard does not show any pitch bend control or indicator.

risks.risk: The keyboard may not have pitch bend functionality as claimed.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the control panel showing the pitch bend knob or its label, or a video demonstrating the pitch bend function.

risks.risk: The keyboard may be damaged or have internal faults not visible in the photo.
risks.proof: A video showing the keyboard powered on, keys responding, and all functions working.

risks.risk: The keyboard may be missing accessories (e.g., power adapter, stand, or sustain pedal).
risks.proof: A photo showing all included accessories laid out next to the keyboard.

proof_requests: Close-up of the sticker with the model number, usually inside the door or on the inside of the battery door.
A close-up photo of the control panel showing the pitch bend knob or its label.
A video showing the keyboard powered on and all keys and functions working.
A photo of all included accessories.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
